title: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c:235: DAO-ACK D-flag bit position wrong in write
description: Line 235 sets D-flag at bit 6 (0x40) but RFC 6550 section 6.4 specifies bit 7, and lichen_rpl_dao_ack_parse reads bit 7. A DAO-ACK with DODAGID present will be misinterpreted: parse sees D=0, zeros the dodag_id field instead of reading it, and interprets the 16-byte DODAGID as options starting at byte 4. Fix: change 0x40 to 0x80.
close_reason: Already fixed: D-flag bit position corrected from 0x40 (bit 6) to 0x80 (bit 7) in lichen_rpl_dao_ack_write(), mask updated to 0x7F. 252 RPL tests pass.
